data.title: Ted Lasso returns to the pitch
data.description: Apple’s biggest show was thought to be over for good, but Ted Lasso returns with its 10-episode new season on Aug 5, with one episode, followed by new episodes every Wednesday through Oct 7 on Apple TV.

data.title: Ariana Grande withdraws from London musical, seeks to 'step back'
data.description: WASHINGTON - Pop star Ariana Grande has dropped out of what would have been her debut appearance in London's West End, the show's producers said on Sunday, as a representative for the singer said she wants to take a "step back" from the public eye.

data.title: Diage Festival returns to Cloud11 in Bangkok
data.description: Diage Festival, Thailand's leading digital arts and electronic music festival, is set to return from Oct 31 to Nov 1 at Cloud11 in Bangkok, promising another immersive celebration of cutting-edge audiovisual experiences.

data.title: Chiang Mai screens Thai-Japanese film programme
data.description: Dude, Movie presents "Hearing The Voice Of Absence", a programme of eight Thai and Japanese films, at Suan Anya in Chiang Mai, from Friday to Sunday.

data.title: Democrats' balancing act
data.description: The Democrat Party has long occupied a distinctive place in Thai politics. Traditionally seen as a conservative, pro-establishment party that nevertheless embraces parliamentary democracy and liberal economic policies, it has often served as a bridge between the traditional establishment and urban middle-class voters.

data.title: High stakes, low payoff
data.description: A woman is forced back into a life of crime after being double-crossed by the person she loves most in Apple TV's new thriller series Lucky.

data.title: Nolan's 'Odyssey' boosts sales of mythology tales in UK
data.description: LONDON - Christopher Nolan's adaptation of The Odyssey has not only lured legions of fans to cinemas, but sparked huge interest in the United Kingdom in Homer's epic poem and other Greek and Roman mythology works.

data.title: BTS pulls out of Grammys amid ‘Asian pop’ dispute
data.description: SEOUL - The global K-pop superstars BTS say they will not submit their music for next year’s Grammy Awards, after the Recording Academy introduced a new Asian pop category that has been criticised for limiting the success of regional artists.

data.title: Group exhibition explores Thailand's changing contemporary art scene
data.description: Art lovers are invited to comprehend the changing directions of Thai contemporary art during "Transverse: Navigating Emerging Thai Art", which is running at Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok's Art Space by Moca Bangkok, until Sept 27.

data.title: 'One World', two artists at Gallery VER
data.description: Gallery VER presents "Unus Mundus", which draws inspiration from expressions of belief and faith embedded in Eastern traditions, societies and cultures, from Saturday to Sept 26.

data.title: US actor Jared Leto denies latest accusations of sexual assault
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - US actor and singer Jared Leto on Wednesday denied allegations of sexual assault and harassment leveled against him by ten women in a new documentary aired by the BBC.

data.title: BTS pulls out of Grammys after Asian pop category introduction
data.description: SEOUL - Global K-pop sensation BTS said on Wednesday they will not submit their music for next year's Grammy Awards, following the Recording Academy's introduction of new categories that include the Best Asian Pop Music Performance.

data.title: Oscar-winning musician Glen Hansard dies in motorcycle crash
data.description: DUBLIN - The Irish musician Glen Hansard, who won a Best Original Song Oscar in 2008 for the indie film “Once”, died in a motorcycle crash at the age ​of 56 early on ⁠Wednesday, his management company said.
